# Life Safety Express

> > Life Safety Express provides comprehensive healthcare regulatory compliance consulting and life safety assessments aligned with Joint Commission, NFPA, and CMS standards.

Life Safety Express specializes in helping healthcare facilities achieve and maintain regulatory compliance through expert consulting, audits, training, and facility assessments. The company serves healthcare organizations across the United States, offering specialized services in fire safety, emergency preparedness, and life safety code compliance.

## Key Topics

- Life Safety Code
- The Joint Commission (TJC)
- NFPA (National Fire Protection Association)
- CMS (Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services)
- Life Safety Audits
- Regulatory Compliance
- Fire Safety Assessment
- Emergency Preparedness
- Healthcare Facility Safety
- Life Safety Drawings
- Mock Surveys
- Code Compliance
- Facility Safety Plans
- Policy Development

## Core Services

- [Our Services](https://lifesafetyexpress.com/about/our-services): Overview of Life Safety Express consulting and compliance services.
- [Life Safety Audits](https://lifesafetyexpress.com/about/our-services/life-safety-audits): Comprehensive life safety audits identifying hazards and compliance risks.
- [Regulatory Compliance Consulting](https://lifesafetyexpress.com/about/our-services/regulatory-compliance): Expert guidance on healthcare regulations and life safety compliance.
- [Fire Safety Assessments](https://lifesafetyexpress.com/about/our-services/fire-safety-assessment): Comprehensive fire safety protocol and system evaluations for healthcare.
- [Code Compliance Assistance](https://lifesafetyexpress.com/about/our-services/code-compliance): Guidance on meeting safety codes and standards in healthcare environments.

## Specialized Assessments & Planning

- [On-site Mock Life Safety Surveys](https://lifesafetyexpress.com/about/our-services/on-site-mock-surveys): Mock life safety surveys to prepare facilities for regulatory inspections.
- [Healthcare Facility Safety Plans](https://lifesafetyexpress.com/about/our-services/facility-safety-plans): Customized emergency and safety plans for healthcare facilities.
- [Life Safety Drawings](https://lifesafetyexpress.com/about/our-services/life-safety-drawings): Development and improvement of life safety drawings for facilities.
- [Drawing Corrections & Updates](https://lifesafetyexpress.com/about/our-services/life-safety-drawings/drawing-corrections-updates): Accurate life safety drawing corrections and updates for compliance.
- [Fire Door Inspections](https://lifesafetyexpress.com/about/our-services/fire-door-inspections): Annual NFPA 80 fire door inspection and compliance services.
- [Above Ceiling Assessment](https://lifesafetyexpress.com/about/our-services/life-safety-audits/above-ceiling-assessment): Above ceiling space assessment service for facility safety compliance.

## Training & Support

- [Emergency Preparedness Training](https://lifesafetyexpress.com/about/our-services/emergency-preparedness): Emergency preparedness training and crisis management for healthcare facilities.

- [Regulatory Support](https://lifesafetyexpress.com/about/our-services/regulatory-support): Regulatory support and life safety expertise for healthcare compliance.
